blocks.prompt: 11. Find the number of ways in which 5 men and 5 women can be seated at a round table in such a way that no two persons of the same sex sit together.
blocks.explanation:
Na do mard saath bethein na do khawateen. Is ka matlab seats lazmi tor par baari baari hon gi: mard, khatoon, mard, khatoon.
Plan: pehle mardon ko gol table par bithayen, phir khawateen ko un ke darmiyan ke gaps mein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 5 mard, 5 khawateen, round table, ek hi jins (sex) ke do log saath nahi.
Humein find karna hai: bethne ke tareeqe.
Tareeqa: Mard gol tarteeb mein \((5 - 1)!\). Khawateen 5 gaps mein \(5!\). Phir multiply.

Mardon ko bithayen
\[(5 - 1)! = 4! = 24\]
Kyun: 5 mukhtalif mard gol table par: ek fix, baaqi 4 ke 4! tareeqe. Gol table ka 'ghoomne' wala asar yahin khatam ho gaya.

Khawateen ko gaps mein bithayen
\[5! = 120\]
Kyun: 5 mard gol table par 5 gaps chhorte hain. Har gap mein ek khatoon bithane se tarteeb baari baari ho jati hai, aur do mard bhi saath nahi rehte. Ab gaps mardon ki wajah se pehchane ja sakte hain, is liye khawateen 5! tareeqon se.
Dhyan dein: Khawateen ke liye \(4!\) lena ghalat hai; ghoomne ka asar sirf ek dafa ginna hai.

Multiply karein
\[4! \times 5! = 24 \times 120 = 2880\]
Kyun: Mardon ki har tarteeb ke saath khawateen ki har tarteeb (Fundamental Principle of Counting).

Tasdeeq
\[\text{same count as Question 4}\]
Kyun: 5 mard aur 5 khawateen hon to 'koi do khawateen saath nahi' ki shart khud baari baari tarteeb bana deti hai, is liye Sawal 4 aur Sawal 11 asal mein ek hi sawal hain aur dono ka jawab 2880 hai. Gol table par barabar ginti mein sirf ek baari baari pattern banta hai, is liye 2 se multiply nahi karte (seedhi line mein MWMW aur WMWM do pattern hote).
